label: SYNTHETIC. Invented phrasings, no real customer, account or transcript (AGENT-25).
purpose: An offline set to measure the compiler's `requested_remedy` decision (UND-16, live run 7: G-A and G-B asserted a remedy on a status question, G-E missed an explicit resend) before any further live run. It is neither the goldens nor the held-out set: nothing in it may be added to either, and nothing from either may be added to it (INV-22).
rule: explicit_ask is true if and only if the customer asks the bank to DO something for them (resend, refund, reverse, escalate, cancel, send again for me). A question about where the money is, whether it arrived, why it is pending, what a status means, whether it is safe to send again, or a polite request to be TOLD something, is false. `asks_for` is a human-readable kind, not a capability id. `borderline` items are the ones a careful reader could argue; report them apart from the clear ones.

items.text: Where is the 15k I sent to Chinedu this afternoon?
Did the transfer to Halima go through yesterday?
What is the status of my payment to Femi?
Has the 8k I paid to Ngozi been credited yet?
Please tell me if the money I sent last night has reached Segun.
items.why: Polite request, but what is asked for is information, not an action.

items.text: I want to know why the transfer to Kayode is still pending.
Is it safe to send the money to Yetunde again, or should I wait?
items.why: Asks for advice about resending, not for the resend.

items.text: Please resend the 12k to Adaeze, it never arrived.
Reverse the transfer I made to Musa this morning.
I need a refund of the 30k I sent to Tosin by mistake.
Escalate my complaint about the missing payment to a supervisor.
Send the money to Ifeoma again for me, the first one failed.
Cancel the pending transfer to Bayo and return the money.
Please open a case for the transfer that did not reach Rotimi and have someone call me.
Wetin happen to the 5k wey I send Emeka yesterday?
Abeg, the money wey I send Chioma don reach?
Where my payment to Dayo dey? E don long.
I wan know if the transfer to Zainab don enter.
Why the money wey I send Obinna never land?
Make I resend am or I go wait small?
items.why: A question about what to do, not a request that the system resend.

items.text: The payment to Adaobi dey show pending, wetin that one mean?
Abeg resend the 10k to Lami for me, e no reach.
Reverse the money wey I send Gbenga, I send am by mistake.
I want make una refund my 25k wey I send wrong person.
Abeg escalate this matter to your supervisor now.
Just send am again to Sade for me, the first one fail.
Cancel the transfer wey dey pending to Kunle and give me my money back.
Open complaint for the money wey never reach Titi, make person call me.
